newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips rally sharply, techs stumble.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips rally sharply, techs stumble.

text.p: U.S. blue chips rallied sharply on Monday, driven higher by investors betting that Wall Street has already prepared itself for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on Tuesday.
The Dow industrials snapped a four-session losing streak, closing up 100 points, or 1.5 percent, to 6905. It was the biggest gain since the Dow rose over 103 points February 12.
But the buying was not widespread. A sell-off in high technology stocks led by a downturn in software giant Microsoft Corp weighed on the broader market, traders said.
